sentences.english: Can you speak English?
sentences.chinese: 你会说英语吗？

sentences.english: I need to speak with you about something important after class.
sentences.chinese: 下课后我需要和你谈件重要的事。

sentences.english: When I first moved here, I was too shy to speak to anyone, but now I can speak English well enough to make friends and even tell jokes.
sentences.chinese: 我刚搬来的时候太害羞，不敢和任何人说话，但现在我的英语足够好，能交朋友甚至开玩笑了。
sentences.scene: 讲述语言进步带来的改变

sentences.english: The weather is nice today.
sentences.chinese: 今天天气很好。

sentences.english: Let's check the weather before we go hiking this weekend.
sentences.chinese: 我们这个周末去远足之前先看看天气吧。
sentences.scene: 计划户外活动前查看天气

sentences.english: I love the weather in fall, when it's cool enough for a sweater but still sunny enough to sit outside and read a book.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢秋天的天气，凉快得可以穿毛衣，但阳光还足以坐在外面看书。

sentences.english: It's sunny outside.
sentences.chinese: 外面是晴天。

sentences.english: We should go to the beach since it's so sunny today.
sentences.chinese: 今天阳光这么好，我们应该去海滩。

sentences.english: I always feel more energetic on sunny days because I can open all the windows, let the sunshine in, and just enjoy the brightness.
sentences.chinese: 晴朗的日子里我总是觉得更有活力，因为我可以打开所有窗户，让阳光进来，享受那份明亮。
sentences.scene: 描述晴天带来的好心情

sentences.english: This soup is very hot.
sentences.chinese: 这汤很烫。

sentences.english: It's so hot today that I don't want to move at all.
sentences.chinese: 今天热得我完全不想动。

sentences.english: Last summer was the hottest I can remember, and our air conditioner broke down twice, so we practically lived in the basement for a week.
sentences.chinese: 去年夏天是我记忆中最热的，我们空调坏了两次，所以几乎在地下室住了一周。

sentences.english: That's a bad idea.
sentences.chinese: 那是个坏主意。

sentences.english: I had a bad day at work, so I just want to relax at home.
sentences.chinese: 我今天上班很糟糕，所以只想在家放松。

sentences.english: The traffic was so bad this morning that I was almost an hour late for the meeting, and my boss was not happy about it at all.
sentences.chinese: 今天早上交通太糟糕了，我开会迟到了快一个小时，我老板对此很不高兴。
sentences.scene: 讲述因交通糟糕而迟到

sentences.english: It's very cold outside.
sentences.chinese: 外面很冷。

sentences.english: I caught a cold last week and had to stay home from school.
sentences.chinese: 上周我感冒了，只好请假在家。

sentences.english: Even though it was freezing cold, we still went ice skating on the lake because it's our favorite winter tradition.
sentences.chinese: 尽管天寒地冻，我们还是去湖上滑冰了，因为那是我们最爱的冬季传统。
sentences.scene: 不惧严寒进行冬季活动

sentences.english: It's windy today.
sentences.chinese: 今天刮风。

sentences.english: It was so windy that my umbrella turned inside out.
sentences.chinese: 风太大了，我的伞都被吹翻了。

sentences.english: I love flying kites on windy days because you don't have to run at all; you just let out the string and the wind does all the work.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢在刮风天放风筝，因为根本不用跑，放出线，风就帮你把一切搞定了。
sentences.scene: 享受放风筝的轻松乐趣

sentences.english: The sky is cloudy.
sentences.chinese: 天空多云。

sentences.english: It looks cloudy, so you should bring an umbrella just in case.
sentences.chinese: 天看起来阴阴的，你最好带把伞以防万一。

sentences.english: The picnic wasn't as bad as we thought it would be; even though it was cloudy all day, at least it didn't rain and the temperature was perfect.
sentences.chinese: 野餐并没有我们想的那么糟，虽然整天阴天，但至少没下雨，温度也刚刚好。

sentences.english: I love rainy days.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢下雨天。

sentences.english: The streets get really muddy on rainy days, so wear your boots.
sentences.chinese: 下雨天街道会变得很泥泞，穿上你的靴子。

sentences.english: On rainy weekends, I like to stay in bed with a good book and listen to the rain tapping against the window; it's the most relaxing thing ever.
sentences.chinese: 下雨的周末，我喜欢赖在床上看一本好书，听着雨点敲打窗户的声音，那真是最放松的事了。

sentences.english: It's snowy outside.
sentences.chinese: 外面在下雪。

sentences.english: The roads are very slippery when it's snowy, so drive carefully.
sentences.chinese: 下雪天路面很滑，开车要小心。
sentences.scene: 提醒家人雪天驾驶安全

sentences.english: I'll never forget that snowy Christmas morning when we woke up to find the whole yard covered in thick white snow, and we spent the whole day building a snow fort.
sentences.chinese: 我永远忘不了那个下雪的圣诞节早晨，我们醒来发现整个院子盖满了厚厚的白雪，我们花了一整天建了一个雪堡。
sentences.scene: 回忆童年下雪圣诞节的快乐

sentences.english: This jacket looks cool.
sentences.chinese: 这件夹克看起来很酷。

sentences.english: The evenings here are nice and cool, perfect for a walk.
sentences.chinese: 这里的夜晚凉爽宜人，很适合散步。

sentences.english: My older brother taught me how to skateboard, and I thought he was the coolest person ever when he landed that trick without falling.
sentences.chinese: 我哥哥教我玩滑板，当他成功做出那个动作还没摔倒时，我觉得他简直酷毙了。

sentences.english: The soup keeps me warm.
sentences.chinese: 这汤让我暖和。

sentences.english: Make sure to dress warm because it's supposed to get colder tonight.
sentences.chinese: 穿暖和点，今晚会更冷。
sentences.scene: 妈妈叮嘱孩子多穿衣服

sentences.english: I love the feeling of coming into a warm house after walking in the snow, smelling hot chocolate and taking off my wet gloves.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢在雪中行走后走进温暖的房子，闻到热巧克力的香味，脱下湿手套的那种感觉。
sentences.scene: 描述冬日进屋的温暖时刻

sentences.english: See you tomorrow!
sentences.chinese: 明天见！

sentences.english: I have a big exam tomorrow, so I need to study tonight.
sentences.chinese: 我明天有个大考，今晚必须复习。

sentences.english: Let's not worry about all these problems today; we can deal with them tomorrow when we're fresh and have a clear mind.
sentences.chinese: 我们今天别担心这些问题了，明天精力充沛、头脑清醒时再处理吧。

sentences.english: It might rain later.
sentences.chinese: 过会儿可能会下雨。

sentences.english: We got caught in the rain without umbrellas and had to run all the way home.
sentences.chinese: 我们没带伞被雨淋了，只好一路跑回家。

sentences.english: The farmers were so happy when it finally started to rain after weeks of dry weather, because their crops were really starting to suffer.
sentences.chinese: 干旱了好几周后终于下雨了，农民们高兴极了，因为他们的庄稼真的快撑不住了。

sentences.english: The store is closed now.
sentences.chinese: 商店现在关门了。
sentences.scene: 看到商店关门告知同伴

sentences.english: I tried to go to the museum, but it was closed on Mondays.
sentences.chinese: 我本来想去博物馆，但周一闭馆。

sentences.english: We drove all the way to the beach, but when we got there, the gate was closed because of a storm warning, so we had to turn around and go home.
sentences.chinese: 我们开了很远的路到海边，但到了却发现因为暴风雨预警大门关着，只好掉头回家。

sentences.english: Let's watch a film tonight.
sentences.chinese: 今晚我们看个电影吧。

sentences.english: Have you seen that new film about the space adventure? It looks amazing.
sentences.chinese: 你看那部新的太空冒险电影了吗？看起来很精彩。
sentences.scene: 和朋友讨论新上映电影

sentences.english: When I was little, my dad would set up a projector in the backyard and we'd watch old films under the stars, and that's how I fell in love with movies.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候，爸爸会在后院支起投影仪，我们在星空下看老电影，我就是这样爱上电影的。
sentences.scene: 回忆童年露天观影的经历

sentences.english: Good idea!
sentences.chinese: 好主意！

sentences.english: I have no idea what to get my mom for her birthday.
sentences.chinese: 我完全不知道给我妈妈买什么生日礼物。

sentences.english: The idea of traveling around the world seemed impossible at first, but after saving for three years and planning carefully, we finally made it happen.
sentences.chinese: 环游世界的想法一开始看似不可能，但经过三年攒钱和仔细规划，我们终于实现了。
sentences.scene: 实现最初看似不可能的梦想

sentences.english: Birds can fly.
sentences.chinese: 鸟会飞。

sentences.english: I'm going to fly to San Francisco to visit my cousin next week.
sentences.chinese: 我下周要飞旧金山去看我表姐。

sentences.english: Every time I see a plane fly overhead, I think about how amazing it is that humans figured out how to fly across oceans in just a few hours.
sentences.chinese: 每次看到飞机飞过头顶，我都会想，人类能想出办法在几个小时内飞越大洋，真是太了不起了。

sentences.english: Let's fly a kite!
sentences.chinese: 我们去放风筝吧！

sentences.english: The kite got stuck in a tree, and we had to climb up to get it.
sentences.chinese: 风筝挂在树上了，我们只好爬上去拿。

sentences.english: My grandpa made me a kite out of newspaper and sticks, and even though it wasn't fancy, it flew higher than any of the store-bought ones.
sentences.chinese: 我爷爷用报纸和棍子给我做了个风筝，虽然不花哨，但它飞得比任何店里买的都高。
sentences.scene: 爷爷手工风筝带来的骄傲

sentences.english: Let's build a snowman!
sentences.chinese: 我们来堆雪人吧！

sentences.english: The snowman we built yesterday already melted because the sun came out.
sentences.chinese: 我们昨天堆的雪人已经化了，因为太阳出来了。
sentences.scene: 雪后晴天看到雪人融化

sentences.english: Every winter, my family has a snowman-building competition, and my dad always tries to make his snowman look like a famous person, which cracks us all up.
sentences.chinese: 每年冬天我家都有堆雪人大赛，我爸总是想把他的雪人做成名人样，逗得我们哈哈大笑。

sentences.english: That was fun!
sentences.chinese: 那真好玩！

sentences.english: The party was so much fun that we didn't want to leave.
sentences.chinese: 派对太好玩了，我们都不想走。
sentences.scene: 派对结束后的意犹未尽

sentences.english: We had so much fun learning to surf that we've already booked another lesson for next weekend.
sentences.chinese: 我们学冲浪玩得太开心了，已经预约了下周末的另一次课。

sentences.english: That's their car.
sentences.chinese: 那是他们的车。

sentences.english: The kids left their toys all over the living room floor again.
sentences.chinese: 孩子们又把玩具扔得客厅满地都是。
sentences.scene: 家长收拾房间时的抱怨

sentences.english: My neighbors are so noisy; their dog barks all night and their kids practice the drums every morning before school.
sentences.chinese: 我的邻居真吵；他们的狗整夜叫，他们的孩子每天早上上学前还练鼓。

sentences.english: I can't swim.
sentences.chinese: 我不会游泳。

sentences.english: Let's go to the pool and swim some laps this afternoon.
sentences.chinese: 今天下午我们去游泳池游几个来回吧。

sentences.english: When we went to Hawaii, we got to swim with sea turtles in the ocean, and it was one of the most amazing experiences of my life.
sentences.chinese: 我们去夏威夷的时候，在海里和海龟一起游了泳，那是我人生中最神奇的经历之一。
sentences.scene: 分享与海龟同游的难忘旅程

sentences.english: I want to visit Sydney someday.
sentences.chinese: 我想有一天去悉尼旅游。

sentences.english: My cousin lives in Sydney, and she says the beaches there are incredible.
sentences.chinese: 我表姐住在悉尼，她说那里的海滩棒极了。
sentences.scene: 听亲戚介绍悉尼的海滩

sentences.english: Last year, I spent two weeks in Sydney, and I fell in love with the city the moment I saw the Opera House and the Harbour Bridge all lit up at night.
sentences.chinese: 去年我在悉尼待了两周，当我看到夜晚灯火通明的歌剧院和海港大桥时，瞬间就爱上了这座城市。
sentences.scene: 悉尼夜景带来的震撼与喜爱
